title: How Richard Nixon Got There — The Full Life Story #Shorts
description:
What Richard Nixon built in the middle years is what the name still stands for. Richard Milhous Nixon (January 9, 1913 – April 22, 1994) was the 37th president of the United States, serving from 1969 until his resignation in 1974. A member of the Republican Party, he represented California in both houses of the United States Congress before serving as the 36th vice president under President Dwight D.

Few lives travel as far as that of Richard Nixon, and the distance is the point. He did not enjoy the role, and four months later applied to join the United States Navy. Though he could have claimed an exemption from the draft as a birthright Quaker, or a deferral due to his government service, Nixon nevertheless sought a commission in the Navy.
